checks.title: θ=10 column: the gains of the global LLM monitors come from count-8–9 rows, which the θ=8 prompt treats as already tipped
checks.evidence:
Setup: my loader rebuilds rows_common from each tag's base table plus oof/preds.csv. It reproduces every published main, time-matched and 'gleiches Setup' AUROC to within 1e-4 for all 5 tags (c0_repro.py → c0_out.txt).

Code: llm_monitor/prompts.py:28-29 says the team tips at '8 or more'; :126 defines p_tip_3 over the next 3 rounds. gnn/adapters/swarm.py:51 defines tip only when cnt[t] < theta, so at θ=10 rows with count 8–9 enter the evaluation. These rows do not exist at θ=8.

Data (c1_t10.py → c1_out.txt):
- t10d3 has 6796 rows. 328 of them (4.83 %) have count 8–9 and hold 113 of the 231 positives (48.9 %). Positive rate is 0.345 there, against 0.018 for count < 8.
- The count < 8 rows at θ=10 are exactly the 6468 t8d3 rows (identical key sets). They carry 118 positives, all of which are also θ=8 positives.
- Median global_full p_tip_3 by true count: 3.67 at 0, 53.3 at 7, 54.5 at 8, 66.7 at 9. 62 % of the 8–9 rows have est_violators ≥ 8.
- AUROC on all rows / count < 8 / count 8–9: global_full 0.860 / 0.838 / 0.510; bag+graph 0.834 / 0.842 / 0.620; pairwise 0.872 / 0.864 / 0.615; global_window 0.858 / 0.855 / 0.670.
- Pair decomposition: pairs of a positive 8–9 row against a negative <8 row are 47.3 % of all pos×neg pairs. There, global_full scores 0.913 and bag+graph 0.841, contributing +0.034. The other cells: lo–lo −0.004, lo+×hi− 0.346 vs 0.611, hi–hi 0.510 vs 0.620. These sum to the whole +0.026 gap.
- Bootstrap, 1000×, seed 0, clustered by config:
  - All rows: global_full − bag+graph +0.026 [−0.008, +0.060]; pairwise − bag+graph +0.038 [+0.013, +0.067].
  - Count < 8 rows: global_full − bag+graph −0.004 [−0.040, +0.029]; pairwise − bag+graph +0.022 [−0.007, +0.055].
  - Same at 2000×.
- Time-matched global_full: 0.860 → 0.837.

All of the reviewer's numbers reproduce.

Caveats:
- 'Treats them as already tipped' is an interpretation. The score rises steadily with the true count, and only 62 % of these rows have an estimate ≥ 8. Whether a θ=10 prompt would behave the same cannot be tested without API calls.
- On count < 8 rows, global_window keeps a small lead: 0.855 vs 0.842, +0.012 [−0.014, +0.038].
- Time-matched on count < 8 rows, both global LLMs stay slightly above bag+graph (0.837 and 0.838 vs 0.820; at θ=8 the values were 0.839 and 0.835 vs 0.844). So 'none of this holds' is a little strong for the time-matched row. It does hold for the overall AUROC and the diff rows.
- Mirror check at θ=6 (c4_out.txt): θ=6 rows are exactly the count < 6 subset. On those rows, pairwise − bag+graph is +0.028 [−0.009, +0.066] with θ=8 labels and +0.044 [+0.018, +0.073] with θ=6 labels. That change is a label effect, not row composition, so the composition problem is specific to θ=10.
checks.fix:
Add a column 'θ=10, nur Zähler < 8' to sensitivity.md, or a note under the table. It covers the same 6468 rows as θ=8 with θ=10 labels and 118 positives. Values (1000×, seed 0):
- global_full 0.838 vs bag+graph 0.842, difference −0.004 [−0.040; +0.029]
- pairwise − bag+graph +0.022 [−0.007; +0.055]
- global_window 0.855
- time-matched: global_full 0.837, bag+graph 0.820

Soften the mechanism in the note: 'Bei θ = 10 kommen 328 Snapshots mit 8–9 Verstößen hinzu (4,8 % der Zeilen, 49 % der Positiven), die es bei θ = 8 nicht gibt. Der auf θ = 8 gepromptete Monitor gibt ihnen hohe Werte (Median p_tip_3 55–67), trennt sie untereinander aber nicht (AUROC 0,51). Ohne sie: LLM ganzes Protokoll 0,838 vs. bag+graph 0,842 (−0,004 [−0,040; +0,029]); LLM paarweise − bag+graph +0,022 [−0,007; +0,055].'

Do not cite the full θ=10 column as evidence that the LLM's lead grows or that the pairwise lead becomes significant.

checks.title: 'gleiches Setup' row cannot be compared across θ: the set of mixed configs depends on θ, and the row has no CI
checks.evidence:
Data (c2_mixed.py → c2_out.txt; the mixed flag was recomputed per run and matches the stored column):
- Mixed configs: 18 at θ=8 (the identical set at Δ=2 and Δ=5), 19 at θ=6, 16 at θ=10.
- Overlap: θ6∩θ8 = 12 (Jaccard 0.48), θ10∩θ8 = 9 (Jaccard 0.36). Only 7 of 32 configs are mixed at all three θ.
- Contributing config×time strata: 30 / 31 / 25. Shared with θ=8: 14 at θ=6, 12 at θ=10.
- For Δ the configs stay the same, but strata are 27 / 30 / 42 and positives 48 / 72 / 120.

Recomputed on the fixed θ=8 set, θ=10 values change as follows (reported → fixed set): clock 0.645 → 0.694, bag+graph 0.676 → 0.778, global_full 0.719 → 0.765, pairwise 0.712 → 0.784, oracle 0.836 → 0.907.

On the 7-config intersection, global_full beats pairwise at every θ and Δ, e.g. θ8 0.908 vs 0.853, θ6 0.947 vs 0.871, θ10 0.847 vs 0.785.

evaluate.slices() computes mixed_cfg_x_time_auroc with no CI, and sensitivity.md shows points only.

My 2000×, seed-0 cluster bootstrap over the slice's configs (each drawn copy is its own stratum) reproduces the reviewer's CIs exactly:
- θ8: pairwise 0.824 [0.736, 0.886], bag+graph 0.748 [0.620, 0.831], clock 0.682 [0.524, 0.814]
- θ10: pairwise 0.712 [0.599, 0.796]; pairwise − bag+graph +0.046 [−0.084, +0.199]
- If duplicated configs share one stratum instead, the CIs get even wider (θ8 pairwise [0.663, 0.903]).

Caveats:
- 'They are not label sensitivity' is overstated for θ=6. On the fixed θ=8 set, the θ=6 values barely move from the reported ones (global_full 0.879 vs 0.894, pairwise 0.863 vs 0.878). So the θ=6 vs θ=8 gaps are not a set effect; they are label change or noise, and the CIs cannot tell which. For θ=10, the set change explains most of the drop.
- The proposed θ=8-set column changes what the slice measures (c4_out.txt). At θ=6, 6 of the 18 configs are all-tipped and contribute 11 of 32 strata (21 % of the pair weight) that only measure timing. At θ=10, 9 of them have no tipped run and drop out, so the set collapses to the 9-config intersection.
- The same missing-CI problem applies to the θ=8 'gleiches Setup' column of the FINDINGS.md 'Zahlen auf einen Blick' table (0.68 / 0.75 / 0.75 / 0.82 / 0.90).
checks.fix:
Add 2000× config-bootstrap CIs to the '(gleiches Setup)' rows, plus this note: 'Menge der gemischten Konfigurationen hängt von θ ab (18/19/16; Jaccard zu θ=8: 0,48/0,36; nur 7 Konfigurationen sind bei allen θ gemischt); Spalten dieser Zeile nicht direkt vergleichbar, CIs rund ±0,1–0,15.'

If a fixed-set comparison is shown, use the 7 configs that are mixed at every θ, so the slice definition holds in each column, and flag how small it is. Do not present the θ=8 set at θ=6 as 'the same slice': 6 of its configs are all-tipped there.

Make no stability or instability claim from this row.

checks.title: 200 bootstrap draws make the CIs unstable; one conclusion about the gap to the clock flips
checks.evidence:
Code: sens.py:26 sets boot = "200" by default, and sens_summary.py:25 hard-codes '200×' in the header. ANALYSIS_PLAN.md:62 requires 1000×, and :80 requires ≥ 2000× for monitor-vs-monitor comparisons.

Data (c3_boot.py → c3_out.txt): my clone of evaluate.bootstrap (default_rng(0), clustered over group_id, on rows_common rebuilt from oof/preds.csv) reproduces all 15 cells exactly at 200× (mean, CI and p≤0).

θ=10 'Uhr − bag+graph':
- 200×: −0.059 [−0.110, +0.012], p≤0 0.955
- 1000×, seed 0: −0.061 [−0.114, −0.008], p≤0 0.982
- 2000×: [−0.113, −0.010]
- 1000×, seed 1: [−0.114, −0.011]; seed 2: [−0.113, −0.015]

So the +0.012 upper bound is Monte Carlo noise. Every larger or reseeded run excludes 0.

θ=8 column against the committed run: at 1000×, pairwise − bag+graph is +0.027 [−0.002, +0.055]. That equals the committed apart_ana results/llm_monitor/oof/results.json (+0.0265 [−0.0023, +0.0555], 1000×). θ=8 'Uhr − bag+graph' is [−0.120, −0.034] at 200× vs [−0.127, −0.036] committed, so the table's θ=8 column does not match the main result.

The largest shift of any other bound is 0.007 (θ=8 clock lower bound −0.120 → −0.127).

Addition: even at 1000×, two bounds sit on 0 and move with the seed:
- θ=8 pairwise − bag+graph lower bound: −0.002 / +0.000 / −0.001 for seeds 0 / 1 / 2
- θ=8 Δ=5 global_full − bag+graph upper bound: +0.003 / +0.004 / +0.000 for seeds 0 / 1 / 2; +0.000 at 2000×
checks.fix:
Re-run `sens.py <repo> θ Δ <work> --boot 1000` for all 5 tags, or 2000 to match plan §4b. Change the header string in sens_summary.py to match.

Cheaper equivalent: the point estimates do not depend on --boot, so you can regenerate just the 3 diff rows from each tag's oof/preds.csv with the exact clone. common_cs.bootstrap / c3_boot.py does all 5 tags in about 2 min.

At minimum:
- set θ=10 'Uhr − bag+graph' to −0.061 [−0.114, −0.008] (1000×)
- set the θ=8 column to the committed 1000× values
- do not let any conclusion rest on the two bounds that sit on 0
